newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nordbanken shares jump despite poor profit.
newsitem.headline: Nordbanken shares jump despite poor profit.

text.p: Shares in Swedish bank Nordbanken leapt on Tuesday after the group released first quarter earnings well below market expectations.
At 1240 GMT, the share was up 3.8 percent, or nine crowns, at 243 crowns, while the bourse's general index was 1.21 percent higher at 2,609.03.
Nordbanken posted a 10 percent fall in first quarter operating profit to 1.40 billion crowns, which was lower than an expected 1.70 billion crowns.
Dealers did not think the report had affected the share much, saying it was more likely that it was riding on merger speculation.
"It's possible that the share is benefiting from renewed speculation about a merger between Nordbanken and S-E-Banken," a trader said.
